name: annotator
//: The Annotator, a hard fork of elias-sundqvist/obsidian-annotator (NOTICE.md): the Obsidian plugin, built with esbuild into dist/.

build.//: dist/: main.js and manifest.json, as Obsidian loads a plugin (scripts/build.mjs).

dev.//: Rebuilds dist/ on every change, unminified, with inline source maps.

test.//: The fake service, on Node's test runner (test/).

e2e.//: Hypothesis's own client in the built pages, in Chromium, against the fake service, with a harness page in Obsidian's place (e2e/, playwright.config.ts).

install.//: Run by hand, never by a build: copies dist/ into content/.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-annotator, which git ignores, keeping the plugin's settings (data.json). `--vault=<path>` installs into another vault (scripts/install-in-vault.mjs).

obsidian.//: Run by hand: quits Obsidian and starts it again with remote debugging on 127.0.0.1, which `logs` attaches to (scripts/obsidian-debug.mjs). macOS. `--port=<n>`, else 9222.

logs.//: Streams a running Obsidian's console and errors, its window's and its frames' (the viewer and sidebar pages), to the terminal and logs/obsidian.log (scripts/obsidian-logs.mjs). Needs Obsidian started by `obsidian`. `--reload` reloads Obsidian once attached, to log the plugins starting; `--open=<note>` opens a note; `--seconds=<n>` stops after n seconds.
